acceptanceCriteria: Redact secret-shaped URL payloads and credentials before saving events and cover selector-embedded inputs; preserve safe route identity and typed-value exclusion.
Meet the issue's actual visits/edges parity acceptance with trace parsing or obtain an explicit owner decision for normalized/superset semantics; tests must compare the production observe path.
Bound complete serialized documents to the loader's 4 MiB input limit and abstain visibly on overflow; support or explicitly bound directory ingestion above 64 tests.
Prevent stale artifacts from earlier runs, retries without contexts and filtered tests from being represented as current observations.
Qualify per-test writing for contexts closed by Browser.close and other supported lifecycle paths; incomplete collection must abstain visibly.
Retain config-only passing-test evidence under trace retain-on-failure, qualified same-run trace evidence, golden byte identity and representative overhead after repairs.
body: Review of 645304a2fb71065f9061d8d8d866600d703e84c6..3d68f7e8a2b3ed0fdba61207b18c361187d3ede6. Installed Core 1.0.0-rc.3 build407; Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build407. Qualified dependency inspected: Playwright 1.61.1. Confirmed: (1) navigation-events.cjs:44,86 persists raw URL userinfo and token query values; a read-only in-memory recorder probe captured both, violating the review's no-secrets-recorded invariant even though observe later redacts them. (2) navigation_events_test.go:99 folds redirect chains before comparing; :110 explicitly expects two producer visits vs one trace visit. Raw same-run visits/edges do not meet issue #814 acceptance; ANL-V0-042 proposes a weaker normalized comparison. (3) navigation-events.cjs:52 bounds only event count and individual URL length; a recorder probe with 1100 URLs below 4096 bytes produced 4452878 serialized bytes, exceeding observe.go:155-157's 4194304-byte limit. (4) every test goes into one outputDir; observe.go:146 rejects more than 64 JSON files, including the documented 80-test overhead shape. Static correctness gaps, not requalified live: (5) files from filtered/skipped tests and attempts with no context persist across runs; no run cleanup or metadata distinguishes them. (6) writing occurs only through runBeforeCloseBrowserContext; Playwright 1.61.1 Browser.close does not invoke it, and subsequent context.close returns for an already closed context, leaving otherwise passing tests without an events file. Node tests: 5/5 passed outside read-only sandbox; synthetic golden byte identity passed, live JSON hash prefixes/suffixes match build log. Go/live browser reruns NOT_RUN. Corvint impact rejected range binary content; affected plan retains UNKNOWN language/ownership frontier. No source repairs in review.

completion.reason: Codex review findings for #814 fixed across rounds 1-6: URL redaction before writing mirrors observe's parsing (Go/Node differential test), Browser.close flush, size and URL bounds, stale-document clearing, live trace parity fixtures. Codex round 7 PASS; ANL-V0-037..046 accepted under the owner's standing auto-accept (2026-10-11). Delivered in beamfall/corvint#816, merged to main at 469f260b8. Tests on go1.27.2: the batch's focused packages PASS, go vet clean, doc gates PASS, CEM check and seal PASS. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the lane build-log record at the merge commit.
